Package org.drip.state.eostree

EOS Bond Tree Based Valuation
Author:
Lakshmi Krishnamurthy
  • Class Summary
    Class Description
    BondEvaluator
    BondEvaluator exports the Bond Evaluator Functionality to be used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    BondPriceFunction
    BondPriceFunction calibrates the specified Base Bond Yield used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    EventPillarTimeComposite
    EventPillarTimeComposite holds the Composite of the Single Coupon/Exercise/Principal Tree Segments built according to the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    FullBondEvaluator
    FullBondEvaluator implements the DRIP Bond Evaluator to be used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    ProxyBondEvaluator
    ProxyBondEvaluator implements the Bond Proxy Evaluator to be used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    SegmentConfine
    SegmentConfine holds the Confines of a Single Coupon/Exercise Segment built according to the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    SegmentCouponMeasures
    SegmentCouponMeasures holds Measures associated with a Single Coupon/Exercise Segment built according to the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
